subject: Aperture Analytics — marketplace listing evidence, co-sell cadence and demo
messages:
From: Jen Park <jen.park@aperture.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@aperture.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Intro + marketplace listing / co-sell question

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the intro a few weeks ago (via Ben). Aperture Analytics is preparing to list a joint offering (data-connect + cost observability) and we think Redwood would be an ideal inference partner for the workload. Before we get into technical integration, the partnerships team asked me to confirm a few marketplace items so we can fast-track co-sell qualification: 

- Primary marketplace targets: AWS Marketplace + GCP Marketplace (we have existing Azure listing but it's limited).
- Evidence asks: SOC 2 attestation, sample SLA language, examples of SKU/meters for inference-based consumption, and a short runbook for demo/validation.
- Co-sell ask: interest in joint demo at Q4 regional events and whether Redwood can provide a co-sell contact for AWS (we have a pre-existing registry with AWS but need partner-introduced uplift).

We can provide a short technical pack and a demo bundle. Marcus attached the proposed demo flow and a pointer to our security pack. Would you be able to confirm the Redwood evidence requirements and a primary contact for marketplace onboarding?

Goal: get listing requirements in-hand this month so we can lock a Nov co-sell slot.

Thanks —
Jen
Partner Ops | Aperture Analytics

Attachment: aperture-demo-flow-v1.zip (demo assets, 4 items)
Attachment: aperture-security-pack-2029-08.pdf (security questionnaire responses, SOC references)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jen Park <jen.park@aperture.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 17 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + marketplace listing / co-sell question

Hi Jen —

Appreciate the packet and clear asks. Quick answers to get us moving:

- Marketplaces: we can support AWS and GCP listings for a co-sell path; Azure is possible but we typically triage it separately (different metering model).
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II attestation and our security pack are sufficient for most catalog gates; procurement may request additional artifacts (pen-test, data flow diagrams). Naomi is looped to confirm the exact artifact list for each cloud catalog.
- SKU/meters: we expose token-based and inference-unit meters; I’ll ask Ben to outline the recommended SKU mappings for Aperture's usage profile.
- Co-sell contact: I’ll coordinate with our Alliances rep for an AWS-introduced GTM thread.

Can we do a short sync early next week (30 min)? I propose Mon 19th 10:00 PT or Tue 20th 11:00 PT. I’ll also add a brief intake form for marketplace evidence so we can vector attachments into the right review queue.

Best,
Rishi
Sr. Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, Jen Park <jen.park@aperture.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Aug 2029 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + marketplace listing / co-sell question

Rishi / Jen —

Thanks — tagging a few practical asks from an ops/technical evidence perspective so the Aperture team can prepare the least amount of lift for listing: 

1) Security & compliance: we need a current SOC 2 PDF (company-level), latest pen-test executive summary, and a short diagram showing where inference requests traverse (customer -> aperture -> redwood runtime). The "aperture-security-pack-2029-08.pdf" looks good but we still need the SOC2 attachment itself (often redwood asks for the issuer + date).

2) Metering & SKU: Aperture's current product meters on session-minutes and some custom transforms. For marketplace listing we recommend mapping to Redwood's per-inference-unit SKU with a volume band (eg: inference.unit.xs, .s, .m) — I'll attach a simple SKU mapping table after this thread.

3) Demo/runbook: the demo assets are helpful. Would be great to create a 12-minute "partner demo" script that shows: onboarding, model selection (Redwood-hosted variant), cost telemetry, and failure fallback (e.g., downgraded model variant). Marcus, can your engineering lead provide 2 slides that show the integration touchpoints?

Next steps: Jen — if you can drop the SOC2 PDF and a one-page network diagram to the Drive link Rishi included, we’ll triage and confirm gaps within 48 hours. I’ll follow up with SKU mapping and a short example billing statement for a 10k-inference run.

Cheers,
Ben
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@aperture.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Jen Park <jen.park@aperture.ai>, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Aug 2029 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + marketplace listing / co-sell question

Hi Ben / Rishi —

Thanks for the clear list. I've pulled the SOC 2 PDF and our pen-test exec summary; attaching both here (and dropping to your Drive link). Also attaching two slides that outline where Redwood's runtime will be invoked in our pipeline. Quick notes:

- SOC 2: Aperture_SOC2_TypeII_2028-11.pdf (attested Nov 2028 by Northstar Audits)
- Pen-test: aperture-pen-test-summary-2029-06.pdf
- Slides: aperture-redwood-touchpoints-v1.pdf

On the demo script: we can produce the 12-minute partner demo. Engineering prefers the Nov co-sell slot but can do a dry-run with your team in late Oct.

Let me know if you need any additional artifacts.

Marcus
Director, Platform Partnerships | Aperture Analytics

Attachments: Aperture_SOC2_TypeII_2028-11.pdf, aperture-pen-test-summary-2029-06.pdf, aperture-redwood-touchpoints-v1.pdf

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jen Park <jen.park@aperture.ai>, Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@aperture.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, alliances-aws@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Aug 2029 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + marketplace listing / co-sell question

Perfect — this is exactly what we need. Naomi, can you review the SOC2 PDF and pen-test summary and confirm whether any follow-ups are required for GCP and AWS listing gates? Ben, attaching the SKU mapping doc you promised would help us close the evidence loop.

Jen / Marcus — next steps:
- I’ll open a HubSpot record (HS-AP-4821) and copy the Drive assets.
- Naomi will confirm evidence completeness by EOD Tue 20 Aug.
- Ben and I will draft a short co-sell one-pager and propose available demo windows (late Oct dry-run; full Nov regional demo).

If that timeline works, we’ll convert this thread into a formal intake ticket and loop in our Alliances AWS rep for introductions.

Thanks all — excited to move this forward.

Rishi
Sr. Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
